ddl.name: entity_external_identity_unique

columns.value: (case when "user_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "user_id" end)
(case when "provider_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "provider_id" end)
(case when "entity_schema_plugin_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "entity_schema_plugin_id" end)

ddl.where: "external_id" is not null and ("user_id" is null or "provider_id" is not null)

columns.value: (case when "owner_user_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "owner_user_id" end)
(case when "relationship_schema_slug" = 'member-of' and "relationship_schema_plugin_id" is null then ("properties" ->> 'rank')::double precision end)

ddl.name: workflow_execution_cleanup_idx
ddl.where: "expired_at" is not null and "cleared_at" is null

ddl.name: automation_run_owner_check
ddl.value: ("plugin_id" is null and "plugin_revision_id" is null and "plugin_config_revision_id" is null) or ("plugin_id" is not null and "plugin_revision_id" is not null and "plugin_config_revision_id" is not null)

ddl.name: automation_run_stage_check
ddl.value: ("stage" = 'before' and "delivery" = 'policy' and "retry_policy" is null and "next_attempt_at" is null and "attempt_count" <= 1) or ("stage" = 'after' and "delivery" in ('required', 'async') and "retry_policy" is not null)

ddl.name: automation_run_live_script_check
ddl.value: "status" not in ('queued', 'running') or "sandbox_script_id" is not null

ddl.name: automation_run_attempt_state_check
ddl.value: "attempt_number" > 0 and (("status" = 'running' and "finished_at" is null) or ("status" in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "finished_at" is not null))

ddl.name: automation_trigger_kind_check
ddl.value: ("category" in ('request', 'change') and "resource_kind" in ('entity', 'event', 'relationship') and "operation" in ('create', 'update', 'delete', 'batch')) or ("category" = 'change' and "resource_kind" = 'provider-entity-import' and "operation" = 'complete') or ("category" = 'signal' and "resource_kind" = 'signal' and "operation" = 'emit')

ddl.name: automation_trigger_causation_check
ddl.value: "depth" >= 0 and "lane" in ('interactive', 'background') and "initiator_kind" in ('user', 'integration', 'system') and "source" in ('api', 'import', 'integration', 'bootstrap', 'provider-refresh', 'scheduler', 'automation') and ("source" <> 'automation' or ("parent_run_id" is not null and "parent_trigger_id" is not null and "depth" > 0))

ddl.name: automation_trigger_parent_check
ddl.value: "parent_run_id" is null or "parent_trigger_id" is not null

ddl.name: automation_trigger_payload_kind_check
ddl.value: "payload" is null or (jsonb_typeof("payload") = 'object' and ("payload"->>'category') is not distinct from "category" and ("payload"->>'resource') is not distinct from "resource_kind" and ("payload"->>'operation') is not distinct from "operation")

ddl.name: entity_enrichment_request_operation_check
ddl.value: ("operation" = 'population' and "level" in ('base', 'full') and "language" is null) or ("operation" = 'translation' and "level" is null and "language" is not null)

ddl.name: import_item_batch_check
ddl.value: "kind" <> 'batch' or ("ordinal" is not null and "capture_id" is not null and "operation_ids" is not null)

ddl.name: import_item_staging_check
ddl.value: "kind" <> 'payload' or ("ordinal" is null) = (data->>'stagingExecutionId' is not null)

ddl.name: import_run_prepared_release_check
ddl.value: "prepared_release" is null or ("pins" is not null and ("plan" is null or "plan" = "prepared_release"->'plan'))

ddl.name: integration_owner_check
ddl.value: ("plugin_installation_id" is null and "provider" = 'data-json' and "lot" = 'sink') or ("plugin_installation_id" is not null and "provider" <> 'data-json')

ddl.name: notification_state_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'admitted' and "outcome" is null and "settled_at" is null) or ("state" = 'settled' and "outcome" is not null and "outcome" in ('accepted', 'partial', 'failed', 'unknown', 'not-sent') and "settled_at" is not null)

ddl.name: notification_request_check
ddl.value: jsonb_typeof("request") = 'object' and ("request" = '{"kind":"test"}'::jsonb or ("request" @> '{"kind":"message"}'::jsonb and "request" ? 'message' and jsonb_typeof("request"->'message') = 'string'))

ddl.name: notification_delivery_attempt_check
ddl.value: ("attempt_id" is null and "claimed_at" is null and "status" not in ('sending', 'accepted', 'unknown')) or ("attempt_id" is not null and "claimed_at" is not null and "status" <> 'queued')

ddl.name: notification_delivery_settlement_check
ddl.value: ("status" in ('queued', 'sending') and "settled_at" is null) or ("status" not in ('queued', 'sending') and "settled_at" is not null)

ddl.name: notification_delivery_reason_check
ddl.value: ("status" in ('queued', 'sending', 'accepted') and "reason" is null) or ("reason" is not null and (("status" = 'failed' and "reason" in ('preparation-failed', 'provider-rejected')) or ("status" = 'unknown' and "reason" = 'delivery-unknown') or ("status" = 'skipped' and "reason" in ('server-disabled', 'channel-disabled', 'channel-deleted', 'source-cancelled'))))

ddl.name: plugin_config_revision_scope_check
ddl.value: "owner_user_id" is not null or "plugin_installation_id" is null

ddl.name: plugin_config_revision_envelope_check
ddl.value: octet_length("nonce") = 12 and ("encrypted_payload" is null or octet_length("encrypted_payload") >= 16)

ddl.name: plugin_revision_manifest_sections_check
ddl.value: "name" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'metadata' ->> 'name') and "icon" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'metadata' ->> 'icon') and "description" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'metadata' ->> 'description') and "version" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'metadata' ->> 'version') and "package_id" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'metadata' ->> 'packageId') and "client" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'client') and "hooks" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'hooks') and "crons" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'crons') and "scripts" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'scripts') and "workflows" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'workflows') and "providers" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'providers') and "oauth_providers" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'oauthProviders') and "operations" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'operations') and "config_schema" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'configSchema') and "signal_schemas" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'signalSchemas') and "entity_schemas" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'entitySchemas') and "user_bootstrap" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'userBootstrap') and "memberships" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'memberships') and "user_settings_schema" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'userSettingsSchema') and "http_rate_limits" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'httpRateLimits') and "relationship_schemas" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'relationshipSchemas') and "integration_providers" is not distinct from ("manifest" -> 'integrationProviders')

ddl.name: relationship_collection_rank_valid
ddl.value: "relationship_schema_slug" <> 'member-of' or "relationship_schema_plugin_id" is not null or coalesce(("user_id" is not null and jsonb_typeof("properties" -> 'rank') = 'number' and ("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric = trunc(("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric) and abs(("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric) < 4503599627370496), false)

ddl.name: reminder_schedule_check
ddl.value: "state" not in ('scheduled', 'processing') or ("due_at" is not null and "timezone" is not null and "entity_id" is not null and "reconcile_at" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_inactive_schedule_check
ddl.value: "state" <> 'needs-scheduling' or ("due_at" is null and "timezone" is null and "original_schedule" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_processing_check
ddl.value: "state" <> 'processing' or ("processing_at" is not null and "formatter_run_id" is not null and "trigger_id" is not null and "dispatch" is not null and "reconcile_at" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_outcome_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'settled' and "outcome" in ('accepted', 'partial', 'failed', 'unknown', 'not-sent') and "outcome" is not null and "settled_at" is not null) or ("state" <> 'settled' and "outcome" is null)

ddl.name: reminder_content_check
ddl.value: ("removed_at" is null and "message" is not null and length(btrim("message")) between 1 and 4000 and "entity_title" is not null) or ("removed_at" is not null and "state" in ('settled', 'cancelled') and "message" is null and "entity_title" is null and "original_schedule" is null)

ddl.name: user_preferences_check
ddl.value:
jsonb_typeof("preferences") = 'object'
		and "preferences" ?& array['disableIntegrations', 'language', 'ratingScale', 'reportingTimeZone']
		and "preferences" - 'disableIntegrations' - 'language' - 'ratingScale' - 'reportingTimeZone' = '{}'::jsonb
		and jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'disableIntegrations') = 'boolean'
		and "preferences"->>'ratingScale' in ('hundred', 'ten', 'five', 'three-point')
		and jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'reportingTimeZone') = 'string'
		and "preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone' <> ''
		and btrim("preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone') = "preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone'
		and (
			jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'language') = 'null'
			or (jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'language') = 'string'
				and "preferences"->>'language' <> ''
				and btrim("preferences"->>'language', E' 	
') = "preferences"->>'language')
		)
